justification: Enriches 3 satellite pipelines with spatial_overlays data: threat radar zone/TOD context, flood truth compound risk layers (heritage/riparian/wetlands/landslide), granny flat heritage auto-detect. All read-only queries, no schema changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: spatial_overlays table with layer_types: zone, tod_precinct, tod_accelerated, heritage, riparian, wetlands, landslide. 27 layer types ingested for ~33 LGAs.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If spatial_overlays has no rows for a layer_type at a given point → returns None or False. No crash, no wrong data. Over-reporting (false positive) preferred over under-reporting.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Read-only queries. Applies to all requests immediately. No writes to existing tables.

functions.name: _check_heritage_overlay
functions.input: lat: float property latitude and lng: float property longitude from detect/confirm request
functions.output: Optional[bool] → True (in heritage), False (not in heritage), None (DB unavailable)
functions.if_none: Returns None on DB failure — treated as False (safe default, no heritage warning shown)

functions.name: _lookup_property_context
functions.input: lat: float subscriber latitude and lng: float subscriber longitude from subscription row
functions.output: dict with zone/tod_precinct/tod_type — all nullable string or bool values
functions.if_none: Returns dict with zone=None, tod_precinct=None, tod_type=None on any DB failure

functions.name: _query_compound_risk_layers
functions.input: lat: float property latitude and lng: float property longitude from flood request
functions.if_none: Returns dict with all compound_* keys set to None on any DB failure

functions.name: _build_compound_risk_notes
functions.input: compound_risks: list of string layer type names from normalised outputs
functions.output: list[str] — factual descriptions of each active compound risk layer
functions.if_none: Returns empty list when compound_risks list is empty or has no known layers

values.guard_at: granny_flat.py:907 — passed directly to response as Optional[bool]

values.if_missing: Heritage warning not shown — false negative is the safe direction

values.nullable: no — always returns dict with nullable inner values on any failure path
values.guard_at: _lookup_property_context returns default dict on any exception at threat_radar.py:82
values.if_missing: Response includes property_context with all None values — frontend shows no zone/TOD info

values.nullable: no — always returns dict with nullable inner values on any failure path
values.guard_at: _query_compound_risk_layers returns default dict on any exception at flood_truth.py:812
values.if_missing: All compound_* fields are None in output — no compound risk notes generated

queries.purpose: Check if property is within a heritage conservation area or individually listed
queries.if_zero: Returns False — property is not in a heritage area
queries.if_wrong: Over-reports heritage (false positive) — acceptable, warning says confirm with council

queries.purpose: Look up subscriber zone and TOD precinct status for threat radar context
queries.where_clause: layer_type IN ('zone', 'tod_precinct', 'tod_accelerated') AND ST_Intersects(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(lng, lat), 4326))
queries.if_zero: All fields remain None — graceful degradation, no zone/TOD info shown
queries.if_wrong: Zone value could be stale — acceptable since it is read-only enrichment context

queries.purpose: Look up compound flood risk layers (heritage, riparian, wetlands, landslide)
queries.where_clause: layer_type = ANY(heritage,riparian,wetlands,landslide) AND ST_Intersects(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(lng, lat), 4326))
queries.if_zero: All compound_* fields are None — no compound risk notes generated in output
queries.if_wrong: Over-reports compound risk (false positive) — better than under-reporting

break_it.scenario: spatial_overlays has no heritage rows (empty table or heritage layer not ingested)
break_it.what_happens: fetchone() returns None → function returns False. Heritage warning not shown.
break_it.how: granny_flat.py:594 — fetchone() is not None evaluates to False, safe default

break_it.scenario: Heritage overlay data is stale (HCA removed but spatial_overlays not updated)
break_it.what_happens: Property flagged as heritage when it's no longer listed. User sees unnecessary heritage warning.
break_it.how: granny_flat.py:1044 — user can override via is_heritage=False in confirm call. Warning text says 'confirm with council'.
break_it.repro: Set is_heritage=False in confirm request — user-provided value takes precedence over auto-detect

break_it.scenario: User provides is_heritage=True but spatial_overlays shows no heritage
break_it.what_happens: User's explicit value takes precedence. Heritage warning shown with source='user-provided'.
break_it.how: granny_flat.py:1044 — if req.is_heritage is not None: uses user value, skips auto-detect

break_it.scenario: spatial_overlays has no zone or tod_precinct rows for subscriber location (threat radar zone/TOD lookup fails)
break_it.what_happens: _lookup_property_context returns {zone: None, tod_precinct: None, tod_type: None}. Response includes property_context with all null values.
break_it.how: threat_radar.py:82 — try/except wraps entire query, returns default dict with None values on any failure

break_it.scenario: Compound risk layer query returns stale data after overlay update
break_it.what_happens: Property flagged for heritage/riparian/wetlands/landslide when overlay has been updated. Over-reports risk (false positive).
break_it.how: flood_truth.py:803 — compound risk is additive context only, does not change flood_signal or confidence calculations
